text:
emily: heads-up I hit a weird goroutine leak in the Go SDK generator sample app when cancelling the parent ctx mid-stream. repro attached, onboarding flow blocked.

raj: ugh, repro steps?

emily: steps: start sampleapp, call Generator.Stream(ctx, req), read one token, then cancel ctx. app doesn't exit, goroutine count stays +1.

sam: can you paste minimal snippet?

emily: ```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
stream, err := client.Generator().Stream(ctx, req)
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
go func() {
  for p := range stream.Recv() {
    // handle token
  }
}()
// cancel after receiving first token
cancel()
// process hangs, goroutine doesn't return
```

luis: yep that looks like our recv loop isn't returning when ctx is done. I wonder if handler.Close() isn't propagated because auth retry is blocking.

raj: is this on the latest go-sdk release (v0.12.3)? we changed some retry semantics in 0.12.2 that might be related.

emily: yep v0.12.3 from quickstart. repro on mac (darwin/amd64) and linux (amd64).

sam: assigning to me to reproduce + test. quick hypothesis: the stream's internal read goroutine is stuck waiting on an auth refresh/backoff timer that isn't context-aware.

maya: adding note: sample apps should show the cancel pattern explicitly in quickstart. New users are tripped up when they don't see proper ctx usage.

sam: can you attach minimal repro as a gist? saves time.

emily: gist: gist.github.com/emily/stream-cancel-repro (tiny main.go). It reproduces in ~2s.

sam: reproduced locally. Confirmed leak: one goroutine remains. Root cause: auth retry loop uses fixed backoff and doesn't select on ctx.Done().

luis: that's consistent with earlier auth refresh hangs we saw in handshake PR. We should make every retry loop select { case <-ctx.Done(): return } in addition to time.After.

sam: pushed a draft fix + unit test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/go-sdk/pull/129 (draft). Changes: make retry loops context-aware, ensure stream recv/close unwraps errors so recv goroutine exits, and add a sampleapp snippet showing cancel pattern.

emily: will test the PR branch. Also can we improve the SDK docs to explicitly show `defer stream.Close()` idiom? Onboarding folks miss that.

sam: updated PR with Close() example and added an integration test that cancels ctx and asserts goroutine count returns to baseline.

raj: good. small nit: add a comment about auth refresh backoff windows so folks don't think cancelling will interrupt an on-the-wire request (it won't), but it should stop local retry timers.

sam: added comment + changelog entry for v0.12.4.

emily: verified locally on mac and linux, leak gone. :party_parrot:

devx-bot: build #4521 passed on staging, deploy scheduled to staging at 2026-03-23T18:40:00Z

maya: I'll update the quickstart README to include the cancel pattern and a short paragraph on auth/retry tradeoffs.

luis: also filing a tiny devex issue so docs and sampleapp changes are tracked: https://governance.redwood.ai/issues/342

emily: thanks everyone — huge onboarding friction reduced. closing the loop once PR merges to main.

sam: PR merged to main (v0.12.4) and cherry-picked to release branch.

emily: confirmed quickstart now shows cancel example. all good, marking resolved.
